seo_description: Frnds pizzeria and coffee shop in Astana: Sagadat Nurmagambetov 25, left bank. Open daily 09:00–23:00. Pickup orders and table booking via WhatsApp.
intro: Message us on WhatsApp at +7 707 480 92 15 if you need a table for the evening or want to order for pickup.
landmarks: We're on the left bank, in the Esil district: Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street 25, in the blocks around Sarayshyk. Khan Shatyr and Abu Dhabi Plaza are both a few minutes from us; Triumph of Astana is close by too. If the courtyards get confusing, write to us on WhatsApp and we'll talk you in.
hours_note: We're open every day from 09:00 to 23:00, no days off and no breaks, and breakfast is on the whole time.
